resources.string: Queue and swipe features added by this fork
Tapping a video always plays it
Start playback when you open a video, even if Autoplay is limited to Wi-Fi or turned off. Autoplay still applies to automatic starts
Ask for confirmation before clearing a queue
Switching from one player to another may replace your queue
The active player queue will be replaced
Swipe a video left or right on the homepage, search results, playlists and channel groups to trigger a quick action
Swiping needs full-width rows to work reliably, so list view will be used instead of grid or card view wherever swipe actions are available. You can turn this off again at any time.
Disabled while swipe actions are enabled, which forces list view
